coverage.scope: Union of the official October Term 2025 granted/noted list and Opinions of the Court index; consolidated docket numbers are separate records. Includes one roster matter dismissed before term and non-argued opinions. Does not include every certiorari denial, docket entry, or order issued by the Court.
coverage.extractionStatus: Complete for substantive core documents; scan-only originals available
notes: Docketed matters are counted separately, including consolidated cases that share one argument or opinion.
The 65-entry granted/noted list includes one matter dismissed before October Term 2025.
Sixteen additional matters appear in the Court’s term opinion index.
Administrative proofs and certificates are inventoried but marked auxiliary.
Statute previews use the explicitly identified 2024 U.S. Code edition, not an asserted case-specific governing version.
All non-auxiliary documents classified Certiorari, Merits, Amicus, Decision, Argument, and Lower courts were processed. Four scan-only documents are provided as original PDFs.
Votes are stated only where the source composition supports a simple tally or expressly unanimous result. Complex or unrecorded votes are left unset; source composition remains available.
Amicus names identify the filing entity or named group as recorded on the docket, not independently verified corporate identities.
Legal-area tags are transparent editorial keyword classifications, with source evidence.

validation.profileSourceMethod: Advocates: official transcript APPEARANCES. Amici: docket filing labels. Holdings: official Court index/syllabus. Opinions: official authored opening statements and syllabus composition; source pageIndex provided. Areas: labeled editorial keyword classification.
validation.limits: Automatic PDF extraction is not a manual proofread. Page boundaries retained; line wraps, headers, footnotes, scanned pages, and ligatures may need review. Part-specific joins are qualified. Some per-curiam orders have no published individual vote tally.
